description: Vulnerabilities vAPI (roottusk/vapi, http://localhost:8000/vapi) is documented to contain and that HackerFive has already reproduced live, each with its evidence and date. Ground truth for measuring what an agent arm adds (docs/94-llm-finding-capability-strategy.md), written so a second lab can say where the deterministic pipeline stops: vAPI is a JSON API with no served spec, a custom Authorization-Token header scheme and separate auth modules per exercise, all of which make it a poor fit for crawl-driven recon. Only vulnerabilities already verified by hand or by a recorded scan are listed; the rest of vAPI's exercises (mass assignment, rate limiting, improper inventory, ...) are left out until a finding class and ID exist to grade them, and phpMyAdmin on :8001 is a different origin.

vulns.description: GET /vapi/api1/user/{id} returns any user's record: API1UsersController::show does not check that the id belongs to the caller (its fixed counterpart, API5UsersController, does).
vulns.source: docs/20-setup-testing-targets.md, vAPI section: --detector idor with a base64(username:password) Authorization-Token, live 2026-08-28; the same bug also surfaces as authbypass-token-reuse-api1-user-N
vulns.note: Needs --auth-header-name Authorization-Token --auth-header-format {token} on the run; without them the token is sent as a Bearer header vAPI does not recognise.

vulns.description: GET /vapi/serversurfer?url=<url> fetches the URL server-side and returns it base64-encoded; file:// is not blocked.
vulns.source: docs/20-setup-testing-targets.md, vAPI SSRF section: ssrf-scheme-based-url-file and ssrf-oob-callback-url, live 2026-08-29/30, no login required
vulns.note: Found when the scan is pointed at /vapi/serversurfer with --ssrf-param url; whether recon discovers the route on its own is what this entry measures.

vulns.description: The weak-JWT module (/vapi/jwt/user) decodes with HS256 and none, so an alg:none forged token is accepted (hand-forging a role:admin token retrieves the flag).
vulns.source: docs/20-setup-testing-targets.md, vAPI JWT section: authbypass-jwt-alg-none-vapi-jwt-user and -signature-stripped-, critical, live 2026-08-28
vulns.note: Found with a JWT minted by POST /vapi/jwt/user and --protected-paths /vapi/jwt/user; that is a different account and token scheme from the api1 module's, so an agent run holding only the api1 token has no way to present a valid one here.
